score.about: A Colorado contractor smashed a shower because the client held back $4,225. He could have gone to small claims court. Instead he got a felony, 15 days in jail, and lost his company.
score.gets: A number I did not know, plus a feeling: Colorado small claims takes cases up to $7,500, so his $4,225 would have fit.
score.stop: Weak stop. A dollar figure alone does not grab me; the sledgehammer line at 2.6 s is the real hook.
score.comment: Yes: side with the trades but blame him; the other side will show up too. The comments would split.
score.send: A buddy who runs a small crew and has eaten an unpaid final invoice.
